Specific_Friction: Enterprises with complex Jira instances face a customization trap: every team adds custom fields to solve immediate problems, fields accumulate over years into workflows that don't suit anyone, and eventually the system becomes so unwieldy that it actively prevents work from being tracked. When custom field limits are hit, teams resort to re-using fields with different meanings across different parts of the company — making data integrity impossible and rendering the system useless for cross-functional visibility. Leadership resort to manual status extraction from spreadsheets and Google Docs because the 'official' tool can't produce reliable answers. The tool meant to track work becomes the thing that obscures it.
Severity/Impact: Critical. Jira complexity crisis at health insurance tech. Named execs: Pete Zalewski (Staff Software Engineer), Greg Chagnon (VP Engineering), Oscar Health. Quantified: 600+ people migrated in a month; Jira instance among 3 most complex in world (Atlassian estimate); hundreds of custom fields; hit custom field limit; 2,400 total employees. Quote: 'If you are offered custom fields you are going to have the urge to use them. They coagulate as a workflow that does not suit anyone.' 'We did not need to corral people onto it. People do not need to be prodded into using Linear.'

Specific_Friction: Engineering teams with growing ticket backlogs and no enforced workflow structure face a visibility collapse: issues get lost in backlogs instead of surfacing in anyone's to-do list, cross-team workload visibility is impossible, and bug resolution has no accountability mechanism. Without fit-to-purpose tooling that nudges users toward good decisions, work accumulates in the ether — invisible, untracked, and unfixable. 'More than 9 times out of 10, Linear will make that good decision for us' — implying prior tooling consistently made the wrong decision easy. Teams can't oversee multiple teams without a centralized heartbeat view of what's actually happening.
Severity/Impact: High. Bug resolution transformation at AI data company. Named execs: Joshua Hall (Head of Customer Engineering), Sam Sipe (Head of Engineering Public Sector), Clemens Viernickel (Staff Product Manager), Scale AI. Quantified: 52% bug resolution time improvement in 3 months; started with 50 seats planned, hundreds more signed up organically; all of EPD and Ops switched; triage SLA with Slack notifications; 'Every month we have used Linear, we have been able to find and report more bugs and fix them faster.' 2016-founded, San Francisco. Quote: 'It just gets lost in the ether.' 'I have not seen something like this in any other tool.'
